conditions.description: Front-facing, neutral expression, soft studio lighting
Dim indoor lighting, face still visible

master_prompt: Photorealistic professional head-and-shoulders portrait of one fictional adult aged 25-45, neutral front-facing expression, soft studio lighting, centered, full head visible with hair, ears where possible, and chin, generous margins, realistic skin, no text, logos, watermarks or overlays. Not a real person or public figure.
variant_prompt: Use the supplied master as the identity reference. Preserve facial geometry, eyes, nose, mouth, jaw, skin and apparent age. Change only the specified condition; retain a single centered, clearly visible face with full head and margins. Photorealistic, no text, logo, watermark or overlay.
commercial_usage_status: unverified; do not redistribute pending applicable terms and review
reference_relation: images/P0XX.jpg is the reference and first enrollment image; all other variants are edits of that reference.
